1.title: CVE-2026-111497 (CVSS 9.8)
1.summary:
A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.





Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

1.title: CVE-2026-85079 (CVSS 9.8)
1.summary: In EmberZNet 9.1.1 and earlier, a malformed Simple_Desc_req response can result in an out-of-bounds write potentially leading to remote code execution. This response must come from a device that has already joined the network, and the attacker must wait for a Simple_Desc_req before the attack can be performed.

1.title: CVE-2026-85080 (CVSS 9.1)
1.summary: In EmberZNet 9.1.1 and earlier, a malformed GetGroupMembership message can result in an out-of-bounds write leading to a crash. A limited number of values can be written using this vulnerability, so no route to remote code execution was observed. These messages must come from a device that has already joined the network. Only devices supporting the Group Cluster are impacted.

1.title: CVE-2026-94502 (CVSS 9.8)
1.summary: In EmberZNet 9.1.1 and earlier, a malformed Publish Price Matrix command can result in an out-of-bounds write potentially leading to remote code execution. These messages must come from a device that has already joined the network. Only devices supporting the Price Cluster are impacted.

1.title: CVE-2026-104350 (CVSS 9.3)
1.summary: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by a reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to inject malicious scripts into a web page, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must visit a maliciously crafted URL or interact with a compromised web page. Scope is changed.

1.title: CVE-2026-104351 (CVSS 9.9)
1.summary: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. A low-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

1.title: CVE-2026-105779 (CVSS 9.1)

1.title: CVE-2026-103406 (CVSS 9.8)
1.summary: An Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command vulnerability in the AutomatedProvisioner in Juniper Networks Session Smart Conductor allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

1.title: CVE-2026-103409 (CVSS 9.8)
1.summary:
A Missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in Juniper Networks Session Smart Router allows an unauthenticated network-based attacker to obtain administrative privileges by passing crafted URL parameters to an insecure endpoint running as root.

Note that this vulnerability can only be exploited prior to the device being onboarded to Mist/Conductor. The issue can no longer be exploited once a device is onboarded to Mist/Conductor.

1.title: CVE-2026-117574 (CVSS 9.1)
1.summary: A flaw was found in ai-gateway-payload-processing. An authenticated remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability by submitting a request specifying another tenant's model identifier in the request body or header. Because the service does not verify authorization before retrieving credentials from the shared store, it injects the target tenant's application programming interface (API) keys into the request. This flaw allows an attacker to perform unauthorized requests and consume another tenant's large language model (LLM) resources and quotas.

1.title: CVE-2026-118690 (CVSS 9.8)
1.summary: Signal K Server before 2.33.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to download log archives via the /skServer/ziplogs endpoint. Attackers can extract the JWT secretKey from security.json in the ZIP, forge administrator tokens, and create persistent admin accounts for full server control.

1.title: GHSA-x8rm-f576-gq67 — graphql-scalars PhoneNumber scalar is vulnerable to regular expression denial of service
1.summary:
## Summary

The regular expression behind `GraphQLPhoneNumber` since 1.24.1 backtracks exponentially. A string made of a run of digits followed by one character that makes the match fail (for example `"1".repeat(30) + "x"`) blocks the JavaScript thread for seconds, and every additional digit doubles the time.

graphql-js calls `parseLiteral` while *validating* a document and `parseValue` while coercing variables, so the regex runs for every request that merely contains such a value in a `PhoneNumber` position, before execution and before any authentication or authorization step of the server.

1.title: GHSA-m665-v7pm-7grj — zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite & RCE
1.summary:
## Summary
A critical architectural parser differential exists in the `zip` crate (`<= 9.0.4`) between random-access archive readers (`ZipArchive`) and streaming readers (`ZipStreamReader`). `ZipArchive` considers the Central Directory File Header (CDFH) authoritative and ignores the filename declared in the Local File Header (LFH). In contrast, `ZipStreamReader` relies exclusively on the Local File Header (LFH) when extracting files to the filesystem.

This discrepancy enables ZIP archives to appear to have different file paths and contents according to which tool is reading them.
